summary: This is an 8-K filed by Mountain Crest Acquisition 6 Corp., a SPAC blank-check company, reporting the effectiveness of its IPO registration statement and the subsequent consummation of the IPO on May 1, 2026. It sold 6,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, each consisting of one ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth of an ordinary share upon a future business combination, for gross proceeds of $60 million. Net proceeds were deposited into a trust account. This is a routine IPO closing event for a SPAC, not a special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing includes standard underwriting, trust, rights, sponsor, and administrative agreements. No special situation is present—this is a simple capital-raising event.
